tips.text: Check Ticker for Debt-Bonds on every visit; bonds are the real rank-up bottleneck.
Run Narmer bounties for quick standing plus bonds.
Run Vallis bounties to the end; stage 1 pays no bonds.
Mine gems and ores in Orb Vallis; the raw gems turn in for standing and you need the Goblite and Axidite anyway.
Throw Longwinder Bait straight into a hotspot in the lake by the elevator and use Luminous Dye to see the fish.
Run a Resource Booster while fishing; it doubles the Longwinders you catch.
Stop when a Warm window ends and come back for the next one instead of fishing through Cold.
Skip a second bait in the same hotspot; it adds nothing.
Use the Shockprod spear; a Cetus spear damages servofish and a damaged fish dismantles into fewer parts.
Keep 20 Goblite aside before turning any in to Smokefinger for standing.
Treat Solaris United to Old Mate as a one-time slog; you need maxed Solaris for other things anyway.
Expect Mastery fodder: players call it the weakest sentinel and rate only its fishing precept.
